title: He said he was going to apply for the job

solo90.name: Pausa

group90.name: Pausa

lines.en: Rui, I heard that our colleague from accounting told everyone he was going to apply for the manager job. Is it true?
lines.pt: Rui, ouvi dizer que nosso colega da contabilidade contou a todos que ia se candidatar à vaga de gerente. É verdade?

lines.en: He told me the same thing at lunch. He said he would update his resume this weekend and send it on Monday.
lines.pt: Ele me disse a mesma coisa no almoço. Disse que atualizaria o currículo neste fim de semana e o enviaria na segunda.

lines.en: That is bold, because the director said last week that the company was not going to hire anyone from inside until January.
lines.pt: Isso é ousado, porque o diretor disse semana passada que a empresa não ia contratar ninguém de dentro até janeiro.

lines.en: Really? I did not know that. Last month everyone expected an announcement before the end of the quarter.
lines.pt: Sério? Eu não sabia. No mês passado todos esperavam um anúncio antes do fim do trimestre.

lines.en: That was the plan, but my boss says the decision will take longer because the budget is not approved yet.
lines.pt: Esse era o plano, mas meu chefe diz que a decisão vai demorar mais porque o orçamento ainda não foi aprovado.

lines.en: So maybe it is better to wait. Honestly, I wanted to apply too, but I am not sure I have enough experience.
lines.pt: Então talvez seja melhor esperar. Sinceramente, eu também queria me candidatar, mas não tenho certeza se tenho experiência suficiente.

lines.en: What did your team leader say? She usually tells people the truth, even when the news is not good.
lines.pt: O que sua líder de equipe disse? Ela costuma dizer a verdade às pessoas, mesmo quando a notícia não é boa.

lines.en: She said I was ready, but she advised me to take a leadership course first, and she promised the company would pay.
lines.pt: Ela disse que eu estava pronto, mas me aconselhou a fazer um curso de liderança antes, e prometeu que a empresa pagaria.

lines.en: I told my wife I was going to ask for a raise, but I am too nervous to book a meeting.
lines.pt: Eu disse à minha esposa que ia pedir um aumento, mas estou nervoso demais para marcar uma reunião.

lines.en: Then do it soon! If you wait longer, nothing will change, and you will regret it.
lines.pt: Então faça isso logo! Se esperar mais, nada vai mudar, e você vai se arrepender.

lines.en: You are right, Rui. I will email my manager tomorrow morning and ask for a meeting to talk about my future.
lines.pt: Você tem razão, Rui. Vou escrever para meu gerente amanhã de manhã e pedir uma reunião para falar do meu futuro.

teach.goal: Como não traduzir palavra por palavra.

facts.big: He said he was going to
facts.label: Planos relatados
facts.sub: Am going to vira was going to; will vira would.

facts.label: said that / told me that
facts.sub: Depois de said, vem o relato: He said he would call. Depois de told, vem a pessoa: He told me he would call. Não diga said me; use told me ou said to me.

facts.label: am going to → was going to
facts.sub: No discurso indireto, o verbo geralmente recua: am going to vira was going to, will vira would, can vira could. Se o plano ainda vale, é possível manter o presente.

facts.label: asked if / asked whether
facts.sub: Para relatar uma pergunta, use asked if ou asked whether, com ordem direta: I asked whether I needed more experience. Não use do/does nem inversão.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: He said he was going to apply is correct.
items.why: The plan is reported in the past.

items.s: We say He said me that he would call.
items.why: Use told me, not said me.

items.s: Would is the reported form of will.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.

answers: He said he was going to apply is correct. → Verdadeiro (The plan is reported in the past.)
We say He said me that he would call. → Falso (Use told me, not said me.)
Would is the reported form of will. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
